item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows one electric cell joined to a small lamp in Zoya's circuit. The ends of the cell are marked + and −. The lamp lights.

Which claim about the cell is correct?

options.A: The + end is the positive terminal and the − end is the negative terminal; the cell can supply energy to run this small circuit.
options.B: The + end is the negative terminal and the − end is the positive terminal; the cell can supply energy to run this small circuit.
options.C: The + and − marks do not name terminals; either end can be called positive.
options.D: The + end is the positive terminal, but one cell cannot run a lamp in a small circuit.
